description: The plans on sale for one destination right now, with live prices, data, validity and the product page URL. For a regional plan it also lists every country covered; a country missing from that list is not covered. Prices and plans change, so these are the current ones.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code to price in, e.g. "EUR", "USD", "GBP". Defaults to this site's currency.

destination.description: The destination: a slug from search_destinations ("esim-japan", "esim-europe", "esim-tokyo") or its English name ("Japan").

unlimited.description: true for unlimited-data plans only, false for fixed-data plans only; omit for both.

name: get_plans
title: List plans and live prices
